title: Sections of the constant sheaf of modules are locally constant
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $T_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $M$ a $\Lambda$-module. Let $\underline M$ be the constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules with value $M$ on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], i.e. the sheafification in sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant presheaf $W\mapsto M$ (all restriction maps $\mathrm{id}_M$), and write $\iota_W:M\to\underline M(W)$ for the components of the canonical morphism from the constant presheaf to its sheafification ($\Lambda$-linear maps, compatible with restriction: $\iota_W(m)|_{W'}=\iota_{W'}(m)$ for every morphism $W'\to W$ of $T_{\Et}$). Then every section of $\underline M$ is locally constant: for every object $W$ of $T_{\Et}$ and every $t\in\underline M(W)$ there are a covering $\{W_l\to W\}_{l\in L}$ of $W$ in $T_{\Et}$ (a jointly surjective family of etale morphisms) and elements $m_l\in M$ with $t|_{W_l}=\iota_{W_l}(m_l)$ for all $l\in L$. (Module analogue of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-ring-sheaf-sections-locally-constant].)

source.place: Sites, Lemma 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification): every section of the sheafification of a presheaf of sets is locally the image of a section of the presheaf; Sites, Section 00YR (section-sheaves-algebraic-structures): for modules the sheafification is computed on the underlying presheaf of sets, so the same holds for the constant sheaf of modules

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line, plus one lemma for the covering form (as on lem-weil-pbc-constant-ring-sheaf-sections-locally-constant): take J = T.smallEtaleTopology, A = ModuleCat Λ, P = (Functor.const _).obj M, so that (constantSheaf J _).obj M = (presheafToSheaf J _).obj P (ConstantSheaf.lean:66) and ι = toSheafify J P; the instance gives Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J ι, i.e. the image sieve of every t ∈ M(W) is J-covering; its instance arguments WEqualsLocallyBijective and HasSheafify are AffineEtale.lean:124 and :112, whose hypotheses on A (forget preserves limits and filtered colimits — ModuleCat/FilteredColimits.lean:202 —, reflects isomorphisms, HasLimits, HasColimits) hold for ModuleCat. By smallGrothendieckTopology_eq_toGrothendieck_smallPretopology and mem_toGrothendieck_smallPretopology (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Small.lean:203, 234) a covering sieve contains a jointly surjective family of etale arrows, which is the node's form. Not compiled: the AffineEtale instances ask Category.{u} A for schemes in universe u, so the universe of ModuleCat at which the source repository works is to be confirmed in stage 2.
